verdict.rationale: Unity documents a built-in, in-editor AI Assistant (com.unity.ai.assistant) that lets users create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance, and perform project actions through natural-language prompts, which is the core of delegating tasks. However, it ships as a pre-release/beta package metered by Unity Credits, and the depth of its task delegation is not shown. missing for 10: generally available (non-beta) status, detailed docs on multi-step autonomous task execution, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use it to create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance, and perform project actions using natural-language prompts.
